_purpose: City-specific configuration consumed by the five reusable Skills under .claude/skills/ (local-news-research, local-fact-checker, local-article-writer, local-image-editorial, local-newsletter). See .claude/city-config.README.md for field-by-field explanation, the city-configuration-vs-Skill boundary, and how another city reuses the same Skills by supplying its own copy of this file. This is infrastructure/configuration only — it contains no API keys, passwords, tokens, or other credentials, and never should.

localTerminology.meaning: Ward — a municipal administrative subdivision (e.g. वडा नं. ९).
Municipality — the governing authority for the city.
Tole (neighborhood) development organization — a local community body.

articleCategories.note: Not duplicated here — the authoritative, live category list is src/lib/data/categories.ts. This config references it rather than redefining it, per the 'do not create a second competing schema' rule.

sources._note: Every source below is reused from project documents already in this repo (primarily SOURCES.md, plus article 'source'/'sourceUrl' frontmatter fields) — no new official source URLs were invented for this configuration. Groups with no currently-known source are left as an empty 'sources' array with a 'status' note rather than guessed at. 'priority' follows the same 1 (highest) - 6 (lowest) tiering documented in local-fact-checker/SKILL.md and local-news-research/SKILL.md.
